notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search. Primary goal: replace current multi-DB stack with consistent embedding pipeline and a single inference layer that can scale for nightly batch embeddings and low-latency similarity queries for product-facing search.

Primary contacts: 
- Jonah Park (CTO) - technical lead on infra, cares about throughput/cost + vector DB integration.
- Mira Patel (Head of Search) - product owner, cares about recall/quality and A/B metrics.

Requirements / constraints (from calls):
- Nightly batch job: ~3-5M documents/day, produce 512-d embeddings; must complete within 12 hours (pref < 8h).
- Real-time similarity queries: 100 qps peak, 50ms P95 desired for query path (including vector DB lookup).
- Storage: prefer using existing Vector DB (they're evaluating Pinecone vs Milvus on Kubernetes). Must have simple ingest pipeline and backpressure signals.
- Model preferences: open models first (cost sensitive), want quantized variants; will test Mistral/Falcon variants and 2-3 candidate open models.
- Routing & fallback: need fallback to cheaper model when Dedicated pool saturated; can accept slightly lower recall for fallback.
- Data residency: EU customer subset; need region pinning or VPC options.
- Security: SSO/SAML for console, audit logs for all inference calls, KMS integration for keys, SOC2 evidence required.

POC details:
- Using Hosted API for initial embedding runs and feature validation. Ran 3M docs in 24h to test batching; observed cost estimate that scales linearly - wanted Dedicated for predictable pricing.
- SE recommendation: use prefix caching on common doc templates + 8-bit quantization to keep unit costs under targets. Marcus demoed Optimize suggestions for batching window and quantization profile.

Quotes / paraphrases: 
- "If we can't process nightly embeds within our 8 hour window, we can't migrate the pipeline." — Jonah
- "We need a clean handoff to our vector DB and clear failure signals for failed batches." — Mira

Competitive landscape: currently testing Pinecone (managed vector DB) + OpenAI embeddings for baseline; also evaluating Milvus for on-premish control. Decision will hinge on total cost (hosted inference + vector store) and security posture.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to run Dedicated sizing calc and provide 3-tier pricing (reserved monthly commit + burst).
- Finish security questionnaire follow-up (SE + Redwood security contact to join call 2026-03-04).
- POC perf run on Hosted with more realistic doc sizes (500-2k tokens) scheduled 2026-03-08.
- SE to share sample batching config + vector ingest template by 2026-03-03 (Marcus).

Blockers: 
- Internal procurement timeline (Q2 budget window)
- Need final vector DB choice to finalize ingest connector work
- Security: some EU customer residency notes require Private/VPC options for subsets

Attachments & refs: pricing deck (drive link), POC perf spreadsheet (drive path), security questionnaire ticket SEC-4421.
